title: CORE plug-in manifest
description: What an installed plug-in declares (ADR-177 D1). Named by the package's entry point in the group core.plugins. The plug-in's name and version are its package metadata, not part of the manifest.

format_version.description: Format version of this manifest's structure.

core_engine_api.description: The major version of the engine interface (ADR-176 CORE_ENGINE_API) the plug-in was built for.

engines.description: Engine classes the plug-in brings, as 'module:ClassName'.

catalogs.description: A catalog root inside the package (ADR-174 layout), relative to the package.

packs.description: A directory of governance packs inside the package (ADR-149), relative to the package.
